key_points: Intel announced its first external customer for the advanced 18A-P chip, signaling progress in its IDM 2.0 roadmap
Microsoft Azure deal expanded to include next‑gen Xeon chips and advanced packaging, providing a steady revenue stream
AI‑related market rally (Anthropic IPO) lifted semiconductor names, contributing to short‑term buying pressure
Layoffs and Nvidia reducing its stake reflect ongoing cost‑control and investor concern but are largely operational rather than strategic
Overall sentiment is modestly positive; impact expected to be limited to short‑term price move rather than a thesis shift
